work.title: First collection and local storefront
work.next_action: Review shared-story bag and T-shirt back concepts, then prepare common flat artwork and sample quotes.

work.title: Prepare low-budget direct and marketplace commerce
work.next_action: Confirm budget, seller/GST/dispatch setup and pilot range; then prepare vendor and account setup tasks.
blockers: Samples, economics and channel accounts not approved

work.title: No-payment interest cart, private dashboard and complete merchandise catalogue
work.next_action: Integrate reviewed implementation PR; then separately configure production hosting, actual credentials, contact/retention/backups and assess image performance before public launch.

decisions.title: Prepare Odisha Store under Odisha Collective
decisions.additional_quote: Let's start simple: Utkal Store for branded T-shirts and cups, etc. I will use vendors from Bangalore to supply this.
decisions.scope: Add the commercial sub-project and prepare a reviewable starter. Does not approve invented products/prices, appoint vendors, adopt a final charter or authorize launch.

decisions.title: The first four products; only the T-shirt is black
decisions.context_quote: All Branck T-shirt, Jhula Bag, Coffee cup and water bottle - start with this four - all will be branded with Utkal
decisions.scope: Black T-shirt, jhula bag, coffee cup and water bottle. Other colours and designs remain concepts.

decisions.title: Design the first four merchandise items and refine vector identity
decisions.quote: The store merchandise needs to be designed
decisions.scope: Prepare concrete designs, vector candidates and vendor brief for review; no final acceptance, purchase, vendor contact or deployment.

decisions.title: Prepare consistent artwork, product sheets and a story-bearing cup
decisions.additional_quote: The cup should carry some story
decisions.scope: Prepare artwork and sample specification candidates; no final design, spending, vendor contact or deployment approval.

decisions.title: Replace prose on the cup with a graphical story
decisions.quote: That English does not make sense - We need use a graphical story
decisions.scope: Remove proposed paragraph from cup; develop an illustrated wrap. New visuals remain review candidates.

decisions.title: Prominent cup branding and black bottle experiment
decisions.quote: Utkal also has to be prominent - not all image; Refine the water bottle design - we could try black bottle
decisions.scope: Strengthen cup branding and explore a refined black bottle; no final colour or production approval.

decisions.title: Retain both bottle colours and explore premium construction
decisions.quote: Or we can have both; Can we try some high quality water bottle instead
decisions.scope: Keep black and blue; prepare a higher-quality bottle proposal. Materials, supplier and costs remain subject to review.

decisions.title: Plan low-budget commerce and marketplace selling
decisions.quote: We need to see how we enable e-commerce with very low budget and start selling these in amazon and other places too
decisions.scope: Research and prepare a concrete launch plan; provider and budget choices remain proposals.

decisions.title: Use Tasar for the Jhula
decisions.scope: Replace canvas outer with a Tasar silk design target; construction, authenticity, sourcing and price await samples.

decisions.title: Share cup stories with bags and T-shirt back
decisions.quote: I want to have the same design for bags like cups
decisions.additional_quote: Also T-shirt back we can use that
decisions.scope: Apply shared graphical story to Tasar bag concepts and black T-shirt back; no final colour, print-master or production approval.

decisions.title: Explore a long traditional-form Tasar Jhula
decisions.quote: We can try these - but what about a long Jhula with a traditional tusar bag -
decisions.scope: Prepare an additional long-strap soft-pouch concept while retaining existing bag studies; not final material/fit or production approval.

decisions.title: Apply current Odisha identity with historical aliases
decisions.scope: Current project identity and exact historical ID aliases; no new adoption, active roles, launch or access.

decisions.title: Build no-payment preorder interest and private catalogue management
decisions.quote: We will start building the store as an interest-only cart. Where people who want to buy can buy without paying anything- it's a pre-order, and when we have the product, we will contact them
follow_up_quotes: All merchandise we have created so far can be added there. We also need to build a product catalog.
Where we define available supply and unit price, etc.
decisions.scope: Build and test customer interest, private request management and catalogue controls. No payment collection, outbound contact, supplier commitment or production launch is claimed.
